meaning: Independently parse the exact bound composition computation closure in source and emitted ESM, compare its import/export surface and reject explicit ambient/dynamic effect forms before behavior execution.
binding: Accept only a process-registered independent composition binding descriptor. Phase, module root, ordered unique paths, source hashes, exact imports and exports are explicit audit inputs. Source phase hashes must match the binding; native phase observations must later be linked by strict compilation and final custody.
surface: Observe literal named relative imports without default, namespace, attributes, re-export or type-only disguises. Compare exact specifier, imported name and local alias against source-derived expected edges. Observe exact named value exports; reject default/star/re-exports, export assignment and dynamic or import-equals forms. No external import, including crypto, is permitted. Declarations that carry no runtime value may be ignored in source phase only.
adapter_binding: Independently inspect the adapter's evaluateCalculation function switch: exact ordered authored case names, declared argument-name arrays, selected imported Calculation call and ordered core-name to authored-descriptor-value projections. No substituted selector, reversed projection, missing argument, extra statement or alternate call is a binding witness. This structural check does not replace behavior evaluation of the shared input-shape helper or arithmetic provider.
effects: Retain bounded syntactic restrictions, not a universal JavaScript purity claim. Forbid ambient identifiers and runtime classes, async/await/yield, dynamic import and meta-property syntax. Reject dangerous property names (prototype/constructor/__proto__), dangerous Object mutation API aliases or calls, nonliteral computed member access/destructuring, indirect Reflect mutation and scheduler/network/process escapes. The sole prototype-read exception is Object.prototype in the exact [Object.prototype,null].includes(Object.getPrototypeOf(value)) input-shape test; that prototype cannot escape or be mutated. The existing decimal primitive may use the exact non-optional Math.max(1,scale) call, without escaping Math or its method; other Math uses remain forbidden. Existing descriptor-shape checks may use direct non-optional Reflect.ownKeys(d) or Reflect.ownKeys(descriptors); aliases and other Reflect uses remain forbidden. Local result/array construction, memo state, detached observations and the existing Object.assign(new Error(...), {code}) or Calculation descriptor attachment remain permitted. Unknown/unbound import surfaces reject independently of native compile success.
bounds: Pin definition bytes. Reject malformed phase, escaping/duplicate paths, symbolic files and source hash drift. Bound each source file to 8 MiB, each AST to 1000000 nodes and depth 512, and retain at most 64 violations per module. Return every bound module in deterministic order with its exact observed bytes hash. Capacity failure is an audit failure, never a passing prefix.
verification: Compile source strictly, audit both source and emitted ESM, exercise clean scalar and no-Calculation compositions, exact binding identity failures and compiling import, export, alias, ambient, dynamic and object mutation witnesses. Treat audit-input tampering separately from code mutations. No generated endpoint or production provider is executed.
claim_ceiling: Bounded syntactic computation-boundary evidence only. Not universal purity, arbitrary code isolation, behavioral equivalence, public assurance, full CLI completion or authority. Public runner, resource admission and script/input/module currentness remain later R08 obligations.
